title: Everyday Idioms & Casual Slang
description: Ungkapan kasual dan idiom yang sering muncul di film, serial, dan obrolan sehari-hari.

questions.prompt: Temanmu bilang: 'That exam was a piece of cake!' Apa maksudnya?
questions.sentence: That exam was a piece of cake!
options: The exam had a food section.
questions.explanation: 'A piece of cake' = sesuatu yang sangat gampang. Bukan soal kue beneran.

questions.sentence: I'm going to hit the ___ early tonight — I have a big day tomorrow.
questions.translation: Aku mau tidur lebih awal malam ini — besok hari yang berat.
questions.explanation: 'Hit the sack' = pergi tidur. Informal tapi sangat umum. 'Hit the hay' juga sama artinya.

questions.prompt: Susun kata-kata ini menjadi kalimat idiomatik:
questions.sentence: Let's not beat around the bush.
questions.answer: Let's not beat around the bush.
questions.explanation: 'Beat around the bush' = berbicara bertele-tele, menghindari topik utama. 'Let's not beat around the bush' = langsung ke intinya.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat slang ini dengan nada kasual:
questions.sentence: I'm totally down for pizza tonight — my treat!
questions.translation: Aku mau banget pizza malam ini — aku yang traktir!
questions.answer: I'm totally down for pizza tonight — my treat!
questions.explanation: 'I'm down for...' = aku mau / aku ikut. 'My treat' = aku yang bayar. Dua ekspresi kasual yang sangat sering dipakai.

questions.prompt: Apa arti 'spill the tea' dalam slang modern?
questions.sentence: Come on, spill the tea! What happened at the party?
questions.translation: Ayolah, ceritain dong! Apa yang terjadi di pesta?
questions.answer: Share the gossip or juicy details.
options: Share the gossip or juicy details.
questions.explanation: 'Spill the tea' = membagikan gosip atau cerita seru. Dari budaya drag dan sekarang mainstream di medsos.

questions.sentence: That movie was so ___ — I literally couldn't stop laughing.
questions.translation: Film itu lucu banget — aku beneran nggak bisa berhenti ketawa.
questions.explanation: 'Hilarious' = sangat lucu. Jangan tertukar dengan 'historical' (bersejarah) atau 'hysterical' (histeris, tapi juga bisa berarti super lucu secara informal).

questions.prompt: Kolega-mu bilang: 'I'm swamped right now.' Apa artinya?
questions.sentence: Sorry, I can't help — I'm swamped right now.
questions.translation: Maaf, aku nggak bisa bantu — aku lagi sibuk banget sekarang.
questions.answer: Very busy with too much work.
options: Very busy with too much work.
questions.explanation: 'Swamped' = kewalahan karena terlalu banyak kerjaan. Dari gambaran tenggelam di rawa — kerjaan menumpuk.

questions.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat idiomatik yang natural:
questions.sentence: He always gets cold feet before job interviews.
questions.translation: Dia selalu grogi sebelum wawancara kerja.
questions.answer: He always gets cold feet before job interviews.
questions.explanation: 'Get cold feet' = mendadak takut/grogi sebelum melakukan sesuatu yang penting. Bukan soal kaki kedinginan.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat berikut dengan intonasi antusias:
questions.sentence: No way! You nailed it on your first try!
questions.translation: Masa sih! Kamu berhasil di percobaan pertama!
questions.answer: No way! You nailed it on your first try!
questions.explanation: 'Nailed it' = berhasil dengan sempurna. 'No way!' = ekspresi kaget (positif atau negatif tergantung konteks). Di sini bernada kagum.

questions.sentence: She was on ___ during her presentation — every slide was perfect.
questions.translation: Dia tampil luar biasa saat presentasi — setiap slide sempurna.
questions.explanation: 'On fire' (slang) = sedang dalam performa terbaik, tampil luar biasa. Bukan kebakaran.

questions.prompt: Apa maksud kalimat: 'It cost an arm and a leg'?
questions.sentence: The new phone cost an arm and a leg.
options: It was free with a catch.
questions.explanation: 'Cost an arm and a leg' = harganya mahal sekali. Idiom hiperbola — seolah harus bayar pakai anggota tubuh.

questions.prompt: Susun menjadi kalimat slang yang natural:
questions.sentence: I'm going to crash at my friend's place tonight.
questions.translation: Aku bakal menginap di tempat temanku malam ini.
questions.answer: I'm going to crash at my friend's place tonight.
questions.explanation: 'Crash at someone's place' = menginap di tempat seseorang (kasual, biasanya mendadak). Bukan 'crash' yang berarti menabrak.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat berikut dengan nada santai:
questions.sentence: Hang in there — things will get better soon.
questions.answer: Hang in there — things will get better soon.
questions.explanation: 'Hang in there' = bertahan, jangan menyerah. Ungkapan penyemangat yang sangat umum dipakai teman dekat.

questions.sentence: Stop being so salty — it's just a ___ .
questions.explanation: 'Salty' (slang) = kesal, ngambek, atau bitter tentang sesuatu yang sepele. Dari istilah gaming lalu menyebar ke percakapan umum.

questions.sentence: He totally ghosted me after the second date.
questions.translation: Dia benar-benar menghilang setelah kencan kedua.
questions.answer: Suddenly stopping all communication without explanation.
options: Suddenly stopping all communication without explanation.
Pretending to be a ghost for Halloween.
questions.explanation: 'Ghosting' = tiba-tiba memutus kontak tanpa penjelasan. Istilah dari budaya dating apps yang sekarang dipakai luas.

questions.prompt: Ucapkan kalimat berikut dengan ekspresi kaget:
questions.sentence: Are you serious? That's a total game-changer!
questions.answer: Are you serious? That's a total game-changer!
questions.explanation: 'Game-changer' = sesuatu yang mengubah situasi secara drastis. Awalnya dari olahraga, sekarang dipakai di bisnis dan percakapan umum.
